metadata.title: Graner & Glazier (1992) PRL / Glazier & Graner (1993) PRE Extended Large-Q Cellular Potts Model (CPM / GGH) Cell Sorting Reference Dataset
metadata.organism: Hydra attenuata (endoderm/ectoderm reaggregates) & Gallus gallus embryonic cell spheroids

embryonic_cell_aggregate_specimen.species: Multicellular embryonic cell aggregate / embryoid body spheroid (confocal fluorescence microscopy showing cohesive inner GFP-labeled dark-type cell bolus enveloped within polygonal RFP-outlined light-type outer tissue matrix)

cellular_potts_hamiltonian.section: Graner & Glazier (1992) PRL 69:2013-2016 Eqs. (1)-(3); Glazier & Graner (1993) PRE 47:2128-2154 Eqs. (1)-(6)
cellular_potts_hamiltonian.hamiltonian_formula: H = sum_{<i,j>} J(tau(sigma_i), tau(sigma_j)) * (1 - delta_{sigma_i, sigma_j}) + lambda * sum_{sigma > 0} (v_sigma - V_t(tau(sigma)))^2

canonical_graner_glazier_1992_parameters.description: Type L = light (ectoderm / outer enveloping tissue, lower cohesion), Type D = dark (endoderm / inner core tissue, higher cohesion), M = medium

four_canonical_phase_regimes.label: Complete Sorting / Engulfment (Dark Endoderm Core Inside Light Ectoderm Shell)
Partial Sorting / Lens Formation (Asymmetric Acorn Doublet)
Cell Dissociation into Medium (Wetting by Medium)

temperature_controls_glazier_graner_1993.section: Glazier & Graner (1993) Phys. Rev. E 47:2128-2154 Section III.B (Fluctuation Temperature & Lattice Pinning)

regimes.description: At T = 0, positive-energy boundary fluctuations are forbidden (P = 0 for Delta_H > 0), pinning cell walls on the discrete lattice and arresting macroscopic sorting.
At T = 10, thermal membrane fluctuations overcome single-spin lattice pinning barriers while preserving gamma_LD > 0, driving logarithmic boundary decay L_het(t) ~ A - B ln(t).
At high T >> J, entropic spin fluctuations overwhelm differential adhesion, suppressing radial core-shell sorting.

graner_glazier_1992_fig3_logarithmic_bou.section: Graner & Glazier (1992) PRL Fig. 3; Glazier & Graner (1993) PRE Figs. 8-10
graner_glazier_1992_fig3_logarithmic_bou.law: L_het(t) / L_total(t) = A - B * ln(t + 1)  with B > 0 in the sorting regime (T = 10, gamma_LD > 0)
